Pro Mime Types Codebase Map
=============================

WordPress plugin for allowing or blocking MIME types and file extensions.
Supports single-site and Multisite network mode. Requires PHP 7.4+, WordPress 5.3+.
Text domain: pro-mime-types.

Files named index.php are direct-access guards (no executable code).
Files ending in .min.js or .min.css are minified mirrors of their source counterparts.
This repository has no minify command. Do not edit the minified mirrors.
.local/ is gitignored and intentionally absent from this map.


Root
----
.editorconfig                   Editor config: tabs (4-wide), LF endings, final newline
.gitattributes                  Line-ending normalization, binary markers, export-ignore rules for dev files
.gitignore                      Ignores archives, logs, OS artifacts, and .local/ contents
.cursorignore                   Re-includes gitignored .local/ for Cursor indexing
AGENTS.md                       Shared repository and Git/GitHub rules loaded by agent harnesses
AGENTS.override.md              Generated Codex startup rules with exact scoped rule paths
changelog.md                    Full release changelog
license.txt                     GNU General Public License v3
phpcs.xml                       PHP_CodeSniffer ruleset configuring the TSF coding standard
promimetypes.php                Main plugin file: header metadata, version and MIME constants, bootstraps the plugin
README.md                       Short GitHub pointer to the WordPress.org plugin page
readme.txt                      WordPress.org plugin readme (description, FAQ, installation, current changelog)

.claude/
	CLAUDE.md                     Native import of the shared startup rules
	rules/                        Generated Claude rules with native path selectors
		code-style.md               PHP and JavaScript formatting
		css.md                      CSS conventions and layout debugging
		docs.md                     Readme and changelog wording
		javascript.md               JavaScript conventions
		local.md                    Workspace file guidance
		php.md                      PHP, WordPress, SQL, templates, and PHPDoc

.cursor/
	rules/                        Generated file rules and a Cursor-only workspace rule
		code-style.mdc              PHP and JavaScript formatting
		css.mdc                     CSS conventions and layout debugging
		docs.mdc                    Readme and changelog wording
		javascript.mdc              JavaScript conventions
		local-files.mdc             Workspace file guidance
		local.mdc                   Cursor search behavior for gitignored workspace files
		php.mdc                     PHP, WordPress, SQL, templates, and PHPDoc

.github/
	codemap.txt                   This file
	instructions/                 Canonical scoped rule bodies and native Copilot selectors
		code-style.instructions.md  PHP and JavaScript formatting
		css.instructions.md         CSS conventions and layout debugging
		docs.instructions.md        Readme and changelog wording
		javascript.instructions.md  JavaScript conventions
		local.instructions.md       Workspace file guidance and instruction selection
		php.instructions.md         PHP, WordPress, SQL, templates, and PHPDoc
	scripts/
		sync-agent-instructions.js  Generates and checks Codex, Claude, and Cursor rules

.vscode/
	settings.json                 Stops VS Code from loading Claude copies beside the shared rules


Bootstrap (promimetypes.php)
----------------------------
Namespace Pro_Mime_Types. Hooks _plugin_init on init.

Defines VERSION, DB_VERSION, PLUGIN_BASE_FILE, PLUGIN_DIR_PATH, MIME_DANGER_LEVEL,
ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES_OPTIONS_NAME, and DB_VERSION_OPTION_NAME.
_define_supported_mime_types() defines SUPPORTED_MIME_TYPES and applies pmt_supported_mime_types.
is_network_mode() is true when the plugin is network-activated.
get_db_version() and get_allowed_mime_types_settings() read stored options. get_allowed_mime_types() maps those settings onto SUPPORTED_MIME_TYPES.
When the stored database version is older than DB_VERSION, the file loads inc/upgrade.php and stops if upgrade fails.
It then loads inc/init.php and registers the MIME filters. Those filters run on the front end and in wp-admin.
Admin files load only after is_admin().


Runtime (inc/)
--------------
index.php                       Direct-access guard
init.php                        Pro_Mime_Types\Main. MIME registration, upload allow-list, ext2type, image/audio/video extensions, real filetype check, Media Library post MIME types
admin.php                       Pro_Mime_Types\Admin. Settings menus, save handler, plugin action links. Includes the views
upgrade.php                     Pro_Mime_Types\Upgrade. First-run registration and settings migration, with a short upgrade lock


Admin views (views/)
--------------------
Loaded from inc/admin.php only. Namespace Pro_Mime_Types\Admin\Views.

index.php                       Direct-access guard
admin.php                       Settings page shell, tab navigation, and save notices
tab-options.php                 Options tab. Form that allows or blocks each supported MIME type
tab-allowed-types.php           Allowed Types tab. Read-only list of MIME types WordPress currently allows


Assets (lib/)
-------------
admin.js                        Settings screen behavior
admin.css                       Settings screen layout, including tooltips
admin.min.js                    Minified mirror of admin.js. Do not edit
admin.min.css                   Minified mirror of admin.css. Do not edit


Translations (language/)
------------------------
pro-mime-types.pot              Gettext template
